name: gitlab-mr-viewer
description: A local, agent-assisted code review studio for macOS.
author: Corey Hayward

scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:stage && electron-builder --projectDir .desktop-app --mac dir --arm64
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:stage && electron-builder --projectDir .desktop-app --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
